summary: End-to-end testing of 3 deferred features: (1) Dynamic Form Builder, (2) Contractor View + ESI/PF/MSME/GST compliance docs, (3) vendor_admin role. All 20 backend pytest cases pass; frontend e2e (Super Admin + Vendor Admin flows) verified visually and via console.

Form Builder: GET /api/form-configs/manpower returns seeded config with system fields locked
Form Builder: GET /api/form-configs/compliance returns 4 sections (ESI/PF/MSME/GST)
Form Builder: PUT manpower form with new custom field 'test_aadhar_number' persists across reload
Form Builder: removing a system field ('full_name') via PUT is rejected with 400
Form Builder: vendor_admin PUT /api/form-configs/manpower -> 403 (RBAC enforced)
Form Builder: admin user PUT /api/form-configs/manpower -> 200

Compliance docs: invalid doc_type rejected with 400

Compliance docs: VA cannot upload to non-owned contractor (403)
UI Settings page: Form Builder tab default, system fields show lock+'system' badge with NO delete button; custom 'test_aadhar_number' shows delete icon
UI Settings page: Compliance Form tab shows ESI/PF/MSME/GST sections; 'Add Section' hidden

UI VA: /contractors lists ONLY 1 row (own contractor); 'New Contractor' button hidden

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1278 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, users.py, manpower.py, contractors.py, form_configs.py) for maintainability.
In _sync_company_name (line 719) there is a dead expression: 'await _sync_company_name({...}) if False else None'. Should be removed.
filter_for_user returns {'_id': '__none__'} which works because no document has that string _id, but it is fragile. Prefer something like {'id': '__none__'} or a guaranteed-impossible match.

TestVendorAdminScoping permits VA to set any contractor_id when creating member -- the server correctly forces it back to VA's contractor_id (good). Frontend should likewise pre-fill & lock that field for VA (verified via API; UI not retested in this run).
